story_overview: Marcus and Clara have a serious conversation on a cobblestone street at night. Later, a troubled Marcus takes a somber phone call in a cluttered apartment where Alex was resting. The story escalates as Alex runs through the city and Marcus rushes to a hospital to meet a concerned Chloe, culminating in an emotional hug between them in an office.

Marcus: Man with graying dark hair, wearing a beige jacket over the dark blue shirt and dark trousers.
Clara: Woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a black jumpsuit.
Leo: Man with dark hair, wearing a tan jacket over a white t-shirt, dark pants, and sneakers
the dark blue shirt: Dark blue man's shirt belonging to Marcus.

On the Cobblestone Street, Marcus, Clara, and Leo walk side-by-side. Marcus, wearing the beige jacket and the dark blue shirt, walks with his hands in his pockets, looking down at the ground as he speaks. Clara, wearing the black jumpsuit, looks intently at Marcus, listening as they walk.

Chloe: Visibly pregnant woman with blonde hair, wearing a dark blue long-sleeved top and dark gray pants.

On the Cobblestone Street, Marcus, Clara, wearing the black jumpsuit, and Chloe walk together toward the camera. Marcus, wearing the beige jacket, has his hands in his pockets as he talks to Clara, who listens intently. Chloe walks alongside them.
On the Cobblestone Street at night, a medium shot follows the talking Marcus, wearing the beige jacket, and the attentively listening Clara, wearing the black jumpsuit, as they walk together.

Mr. Hall: A disheveled older man in a wrinkled shirt has heavy bags under his weary eyes.

Clara, wearing the black jumpsuit, and Marcus stand together, facing Mr. Hall. Clara's expression grows concerned as Mr. Hall slowly looks up at them with tired eyes.
